digest.component_or_area: test suite: subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Two production-scale real-time windows in reliability tests (15s loopback server + 10s stall window, and 1s deadline + 2s/4s retry sleeps) cause multi-second test latency without reflecting actual contract requirements (throughput, retry count, process cleanup).

The snapshot stall-abort test must run real loopback socket traffic above configured floor for more than one complete window cycle and prove non-stall classification, but with injected sub-second windows instead of production 10s values.

The ACLI subprocess timeout test must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child processes, observe the exact logical retry schedule [2, 4] without sleeping real durations, and prove all spawned PIDs are cleaned up after terminal failure.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults must remain byte-unchanged; no production code, wall-clock pass assertions, skips, or runner changes are permitted.
